requirements.literal_requirement: Required ref identity fields present and hashes match.
requirements.actual_value: identity fields present; hashes match manifests

requirements.literal_requirement: Chosen and rejected are not only opaque refs if the next trainer requires actual payload/features.
requirements.actual_value: chosen_ref/rejected_ref are opaque identifiers only; concrete trainer payload/features are missing

requirements.literal_requirement: Error codes are valid ORCH taxonomy refs.
requirements.actual_value: ORCH-02, ORCH-09, and ORCH-07 are present with taxonomy refs

requirements.literal_requirement: Raw private text is not copied.
requirements.actual_value: raw_private_text_copied=false and no raw payload fields

requirements.literal_requirement: Technical execution refs are excluded from trainable payload.
requirements.actual_value: technical_execution_leakage=false and excluded refs are kept as refs

requirements.literal_requirement: No external AI, no generated unreviewed negative text.
requirements.actual_value: no external AI used and no new chosen/rejected prose generated

requirements.literal_requirement: If concrete chosen/rejected payload fields are missing, readiness must be NOT_READY and next action must be DPO authoring/materialization repair, not training.

not_ready_reason: Concrete chosen/rejected trainer payload or feature contracts are not present.
